statement:
Continuing to use AI for literature searches
will lead to papers reusing the same
citations over and over again.

Letting AI read and summarize papers for us
will weaken the deep reading skills that
scientists need.

An AI that accurately summarizes manipulated
sources is a bigger threat than an AI that
makes things up.

Citation errors made by AI are no worse than
the citation errors humans have always made.

We shouldn't say a report was written with AI
unless the authors confirm it. Clues like
oaicite tags in links aren't proof.
